summary: Start watch without claiming historical coverage, page through a bounded Crossref index-date window on later runs, and save private watch state atomically in the shared state directory with legacy fallback.
reason: A one-page watch silently missed notices, treating the initial page as new misreported history, and from-update-date can miss Retraction Watch records indexed by an outside source. A failed or corrupt checkpoint must not silently acknowledge or lose an alert.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests check cursor pagination with fixed from-index-date and until-index-date filters, first-run behavior without API access, legacy checkpoint fallback, corruption rejection, and private file permissions.
